title: The broken script: Void Paradox
description: Addon for the broken script that adds several entities and a couple of events to your game
body:
**The broken script: Void Paradox is addon for the broken script that adds several entities and a couple of events to your game**



- This mod cannot delete your world
- This mod cannot kick you from the world
- This mod cannot create files on your PC
- The mod may not work correctly in multiplayer 
- This mod can destroy your builds
- This mod can kill everything in your world
- **This mod works BAD with world-generation mods**
- Some entities cannot be spawned in Creative mode

**Shaders for a better experience**
